confusions: The Questions list is very long and the welfare, housing and generations questions are spread across several pages, so I had to scroll through many screens to find them.
The house prices page says the years before 2008-09 come from another survey and are not compared, yet the answer quotes a 2003-04 age figure for first-time buyers, which I did not trust.

The welfare chart switches between cash, after inflation and per person views, and I could not tell from the picture how much the 1955-56 figure was in today's money, so I was guessing at the 'ten times' answer.
The grey header covers the top line of text as I scroll, so I missed a sentence about university fees and the state pension age wording.
The generations answer says university fees were up to 1,000 pounds in 1998 but I could not find the 2025-26 fee figure anywhere, and the Debt page was about national debt instead.
The state pension answer gives 66 for people born in 1960 and 68 for people born from 6 April 1978, so I had to work out the 1990 answer for myself.
The site went to a 'No built site' error and later a 'File not found' page when I scrolled, which made me think the page was broken before it recovered.
The mortgage payment figures are said to be for loans already taken out, which I read as not telling me what a new buyer pays.
